phases.title: The first real feature
phases.outcome: One thing, finished properly: the screen first so you can see it, then everything behind it. It tells us the shape of the rest.
phases.effort: Depends on how big that one feature is

phases.title: The rest of the features
phases.outcome: Each one finished before the next one starts, so the app is never half-broken.
phases.effort: Depends on how many features there are

phases.title: Show it to someone
phases.outcome: A private link you can send. The information is real, and so is sign-in if your app has it, but nothing is backed up, so do not put anything in it you cannot lose.
phases.effort: Shipyard puts it online for you
